name: 任务提示音
description: 专为 PI-Desktop 打造的高并发原生声音通知插件。智能分级节流、内置高保真无依赖音效，多端无缝兼容并支持在线试听与自定义替换。
author: XideaDev
safetyNotes: 调用本地操作系统音频播放命令（macOS 为 afplay，Windows 为内置多媒体播放接口，Linux 为 paplay/aplay）播放插件内置提示音。无任何外部网络请求，绝不接触任何 API 密钥、凭据或代码文件。

en.name: TASK Dida
en.description: High-concurrency task sound alert plugin for PI-Desktop with smart priority throttling, bundled offline audio, and cross-platform playback.
en.safetyNotes: Invokes local operating system audio players to produce bundled local alert sounds. Zero network requests, and no access to your API keys, credentials, or personal code files.
